system_description: Worklog Agent Database Schema. This system manages employee time tracking, squad assignments, leaves, and billing.

collections.name: profilesummaries
collections.description: Central HR record. Contains parsed resume data, skills, billing rates, and squad assignments.

indexes.name: userId_1
indexes.description: Foreign Key to 'users' collection. 1-to-1 relationship. FAST lookup.

indexes.name: user.email_1
indexes.description: Fast lookup by email address (stored inside the embedded 'user' object).

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Link to the 'users' collection.

fields.name: employeeActiveStatus
fields.description: Current status of employment. Examples: 'Active', 'Notice Period', 'Terminated'.

fields.name: jobType
fields.description: Employment category. Examples: 'Full Time', 'Contract', 'Freelance'.

fields.name: user
fields.description: Denormalized copy of basic user details.

fields.name: currentSquad
fields.description: A list of active assignments. Contains denormalized snapshots of the Squad and Client data. Use this field to find what a user is working on RIGHT NOW.

subFields.name: billable
subFields.description: True if this specific assignment is billable to the client.

subFields.name: allocatedHours
subFields.description: Number of hours per day/week allocated to this squad.

subFields.name: involvementHistory
subFields.description: Historical record of involvement status changes.

subFields.name: squad
subFields.description: Snapshot of the Squad details. Allows filtering by Squad Name/Tech without joining.

subFields.name: client
subFields.description: Snapshot of the Client details. Allows filtering by Client Name without joining.

fields.name: availability
fields.description: Current availability for new work.

fields.name: billable
fields.description: Global flag if the employee is billable to clients.

fields.name: countryOfResidence
fields.description: User's physical location.

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department the user belongs to.

fields.name: benchStatus
fields.description: Whether user is on bench. Examples: 'On Bench', 'Off Bench'.

fields.name: assignedStatus
fields.description: Whether user is assigned to a project. Examples: 'Assigned', 'Unassigned'.

collections.name: users
collections.description: User management collection containing profiles, authentication keys, and permission settings.

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Unique system identifier.

fields.name: fullname
fields.description: User's full name. WARNING: Not indexed.

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address. WARNING: Not indexed.

fields.name: permissionGroupIds
fields.description: List of permission group IDs assigned to the user.

fields.name: isManager
fields.description: True if user manages others.

fields.name: isDefaultApprover
fields.description: True if this user is a default approver for requests.

fields.name: isAdditionalApprover
fields.description: True if this user is an additional/secondary approver.

fields.name: lastLoggedInAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the last successful login.

fields.name: totalLogIns
fields.description: Count of total times the user has logged in.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Date the user account was created.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Date the user account was last modified.

fields.name: deploymentStatus
fields.description: Deployment status of the user (e.g., 'Deployed', 'Not Deployed').

fields.name: availabilityStatus
fields.description: Availability status of the user (e.g., 'Available', 'Unavailable').

collections.name: squads
collections.description: Manages 'Squads' (teams). A squad belongs to a specific Client/Organization.

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Unique system identifier for the squad.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the squad (e.g., 'Mobile Team Alpha'). WARNING: Not indexed.

fields.name: activeStatus
fields.description: Current status. Likely values: 'Active', 'Inactive', 'Archived'.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: ID of the client this squad is working for.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The engagement model (e.g., 'Retainer', 'Fixed Cost').

fields.name: allowWorklog
fields.description: If true, members can log time against this squad.

fields.name: squadBudget
fields.description: The financial budget allocated to this squad.

fields.name: invoiceIntervalInDays
fields.description: How often this squad is invoiced (e.g., 30 for monthly).

fields.name: dealOwner
fields.description: Details about the internal sales/account manager responsible for this squad.

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: When the engagement started.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Date the squad record was created.

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: Date the squad record was ended (i.e., archived).

fields.name: defaultApprover
fields.description: Default approver(s) for this squad. Link to 'users' collection.

collections.name: usersquadhistories
collections.description: Historical timeline of squad assignments. Tracks join/leave dates and billing rates.

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Unique ID for this specific assignment record.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: The User being assigned. Link to 'users' collection.

fields.name: squadId
fields.description: The Squad the user was assigned to. Link to 'squads' collection.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: The Client paying for this squad.

fields.name: joinedDate
fields.description: When the user started working on this squad.

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: When the user left the squad. If null, they are likely still active.

fields.name: involvementStatus
fields.description: Current status of this assignment. Examples: 'Active', 'Past', 'Shadowing'.

fields.name: roleInSquad
fields.description: The specific role performed (e.g., 'Lead Developer', 'QA').

fields.name: involvementHistory
fields.description: Audit log tracking changes to this assignment (e.g., role changes or rate adjustments).

collections.name: worklogs
collections.description: Master collection for Weekly Timesheets. One document = One week for One user.

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this specific weekly log.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: The Employee who did the work. Link to 'users' collection.

fields.name: squadId
fields.description: The Squad where the work was performed. Link to 'squads' collection.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Approval status. Common values: 'Pending', 'Approved', 'Rejected', 'Draft'.

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: The Monday (start) of the work week.

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: The Sunday (end) of the work week.

fields.name: reviewedBy
fields.description: The Manager/Approver who approved this log.

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Thread of comments between Employee and Manager regarding this log.

subFields.name: content
subFields.description: The comment text. Link to 'users' collection.

subFields.name: userId
subFields.description: Who wrote the comment. Link to 'users' collection.

collections.name: worklogTasks
collections.description: Granular daily task entries linked to a parent 'worklog'.

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this specific task entry.

fields.name: worklogId
fields.description: The parent Weekly Timesheet this task belongs to. CRITICAL: Currently not indexed (Slow loading of timesheets). Link to 'worklogs' collection.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: The User who performed the task. Link to 'users' collection.

fields.name: squadId
fields.description: The Squad associated with this task. Link to 'squads' collection.

fields.name: category
fields.description: The type of work (e.g., 'Development', 'Meeting').

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed notes on what was done.

fields.name: minutes
fields.description: Duration of the task in minutes.

fields.name: startTime
fields.description: Optional start time (e.g., '09:00 AM').

fields.name: endTime
fields.description: Optional end time (e.g., '11:00 AM').

fields.name: isRecurring
fields.description: If this task automatically repeats.

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave record.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: The Employee taking leave. Link to 'users' collection.

fields.name: squadId
fields.description: The Squad the user belongs to. Used to show 'Who is on leave' in squad dashboards. Link to 'squads' collection.

fields.name: worklogId
fields.description: Link to the specific worklog entry generated for this leave (if any). Link to 'worklogs' collection.

fields.name: leaveDate
fields.description: The specific date of the leave.

fields.name: leaveType
fields.description: The classification of leave (e.g., 'Sick', 'Casual', 'Earned').

fields.name: leaveCategory
fields.description: Broader category (e.g., 'Paid', 'Unpaid').

fields.name: leaveStatus
fields.description: Current status (e.g., 'Approved', 'Pending', 'Rejected').

fields.name: leaveRemarks
fields.description: Notes or reason provided by the employee.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When the leave request was submitted.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Category name (e.g., 'Meeting').

collections.name: worklogClose
collections.description: Defines locked periods where timesheets cannot be edited.

fields.name: squadId
fields.description: Target Squad. Link to 'squads' collection.

fields.name: closeStartDate
fields.description: Start of lock.

fields.name: closeEndDate
fields.description: End of lock.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lock status (e.g., 'OPEN', 'CLOSED').
